day1.note: baseline variance parts on the first forecast day; t_days = days since the last dip; the overview's gap band is the same noise term from t = 0 on the dip to t = age on the day before this one

forecast.variance_note: pooled decomposition over the realisations (diagnostic); the realisation share is not in the band; noise = sigma2 x noise_inflation^2 x (1 - exp(-2 (lead + age) / tau)), noise_inflation the site's hindcast factor on the noise sd (config/fit_anchors, 1 when not estimated)

anchor.refit: kept (0 new dips since 2026-06-29, anchor 3 d old)

realisations.mode: baseline_only (diagnostic: 5 realisations pooled for the variance share)
realisations.evidence: hindcast 2026-09-05 (revised fits), esp_real vs esp at anchor age 0: trajectory CRPSS 0.147 vs 0.387, coverage90 0.959 vs 0.923; season end CRPSS -0.004 vs 0.239, coverage90 0.955 vs 0.905 (first pass: 0.153 vs 0.367, 0.952 vs 0.892; 0.037 vs 0.245, 0.94 vs 0.879)

dips.note: qc-pass SNIRH dips; residual_m = dip - simulation, null before the calibration start

simulation.note: simulation on the observed forcing (gap-filled after observed_to) with the parameters used for the forecast; no residual correction

corrected.note: simulation + anchor residual decayed with tau from the last dip; the forecast median continues from its last value

members.note: weather members only: for each spliced EC46/SEAS5 member, the head path averaged over the parameter samples with the anchor residual decayed as in the median, so the members continue from the corrected path. The parameter and noise spread is in the forecast bands (p05..p95), not in these paths.

pumping.series: no pumping term (m = 0); with one, prec_net = prec_mm - m x pump_mm, pump_mm = irrig_cwb_mm + ada_m3d as a depth over 319.7 km2
pumping.note: no net-pumping term (m = 0): the dips at this site do not carry a pumping signal the split sample can identify

postprocess.reason: sector 'east' is not corrected: the correction was fitted at west and gains nothing in the east (docs/plan.md step 16 (d))

config.shift_rule: the bias is fitted on the standardised error, so the shift in metres is z_bias x the band's own standard deviation on the day: near zero on the first horizon day and largest at the season end
config.target_rule: the season-end target of the drawdown season, 1 April + 183 days; the coefficient vector is the linear interpolation in issue date between the two bracketing nodes and the zero vector on the target day
config.not_applied: the east (the correction gains nothing there: 1 Apr season-end CRPSS 0.540 -> 0.531 leave-one-year-out), 596/259 (sector `uncertain`: one well, so a per-sector fit does no pooling - below MIN_NODE_SITES = 2; its leave-one-year-out fit gained +0.099 at 1 April and is an open item, not a product form), a 1 October issue (0.325 -> 0.260, it loses), any date before 1 April or at and after the season-end target

floor.label: reporting floor: the share that reproduces the 2024 and 2025 reported irrigation totals

inferred.label: M5 inferred: reported titles + IFAP duty of the non-reporting titles (42.64 hm3 in 2025) as a share of the model's 2025 all-parcel gross

baseline.label: calendar-month climatology of the last 36 reported months (2023-06 to 2026-05)

drought.label: the highest 12-month public-supply draw on record (2019-08 to 2020-07, 2019/20) with the same monthly shape

scenarios.note: irrigation level x AdA level; the irrigation share rescales the crop-water-balance draw (and the proxy by share / floor share), the AdA level replaces the public-supply series over the horizon; the default run is the published band (forecast.*, daily). This site's model has no pumping term (m = 0: the dips do not carry a pumping signal), so the six bands are identical to the published band and were not rerun.
